before.text: The projection of fuel tank filler caps and covers shall not exceed 30 mm.
before.test_case: Measure the projection of the charge-port flap per Annex 3 in the closed position; pass if ≤30 mm.

R-0361.reason: R26 §6.6.1 concerns a liquid-fuel tank filler; the specified EV charging flap is a different component.

before.text: The number of front retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No.150.
before.test_case: Count the front retro-reflectors and check each carries an R3 (02+) or R150 Class IA/IB approval mark; pass if two approved devices are fitted.

after.text: The number of front retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No.150.
after.test_case: Count the front retro-reflectors and check each carries an R3 (02+) or R150 Class IA/IB approval mark; pass if two approved devices are fitted.

before.text: For a direction indicator of category 5, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6∙10-1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.80∙102 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.40∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Table A2-2 and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-2 shall be 6∙10-1 cd, as specified in Table 8.
before.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 0.6-280 cd (140 cd for D) and ≥0.6 cd within Table A2-2 angles.

after.text: For a direction indicator of category 5, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 0.6 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 280 cd when used as a single lamp and 140 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Table A2-2 and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-2 shall be 0.6 cd, as specified in Table 8.
after.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 0.6-280 cd (140 cd for D) and ≥0.6 cd within Table A2-2 angles.

R-1059.reason: Normalize R148 Table 8 category-5 values 6×10^-1, 2.80×10^2, 1.40×10^2 to 0.6, 280, 140 cd.

before.text: For a direction indicator of category 6, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 5.0∙101 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.80∙102 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.40∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", and the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-IV, as specified in Table 8.
before.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 50-280 cd (140 cd for D) and follow Figure A3-IV.

after.text: For a direction indicator of category 6, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 50 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 280 cd when used as a single lamp and 140 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", and the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-IV, as specified in Table 8.
after.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 50-280 cd (140 cd for D) and follow Figure A3-IV.

R-1060.reason: Normalize R148 Table 8 category-6 values 5.0×10^1, 2.80×10^2, 1.40×10^2 to 50, 280, 140 cd.

after.text: If the bumper grille or air guide has movable intake or outlet flaps, the flaps shall meet R26 paragraphs 5.2, 5.3 and 5.4 in every position of use.
after.test_case: Assess the air intake/outlet flaps in every position of use against paragraphs 5.2, 5.3 and 5.4; pass if all limits are met in every position.

R-0362.source_quote: Air intake and outlet flaps shall meet the requirements of paragraphs 5.2., 5.3. and 5.4. above in all positions of use.
R-0362.saved_condition: The grill/air-guide parts include movable air intake or outlet flaps (e.g. active grille shutters).
R-0362.reason: Saved, source-supported conditional obligation tied to the specified grille/airflow or side signalling function; exact configuration remains unknown.

after.text: If the side signalling lamp is a category 6 direction indicator, the lamp shall show an 'R' or 'L' marking identifying the vehicle side.
after.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if 'R' or 'L' matching its mounting side is shown.

R-0940.source_quote: For direction indicators of category 6 an indication "R" or "L" shall be shown on the lamp, indicating the right or left side of the vehicle.
R-0940.saved_condition: Side signalling lamp is a category 6 side direction indicator
R-0940.reason: Saved, source-supported conditional obligation tied to the specified grille/airflow or side signalling function; exact configuration remains unknown.

after.text: If the side signalling lamp is a category 5 or 6 direction indicator, its luminous intensity distribution shall additionally be checked 0.2 seconds after switch-on at reference coordinate H5, V0, as specified in R148 Annex 8 Table A8-1.
after.test_case: Measure intensity at H5, V0 0.2 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; pass if all test points comply.
